reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes that reducing oxygen uptake during processing will improve high-temperature oxidation resistance, whereas oxidation resistance is governed by oxide scale formation during service, not initial oxygen content; the proposed mechanism conflates processing cleanliness with in-service oxidation behavior.
reasons.testability: The falsification test is well-structured with clear metrics, but it tests the wrong outcome (initial oxygen content vs. oxidation resistance) and would not decisively address the hypothesis as stated.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it targets the wrong problem (processing oxygen vs. service oxidation) and would not lead to a viable solution for improving high-temperature oxidation resistance in this alloy.
